npcs.name: Yana
messages: Hello Mumu! You are finally here!. Welcome to our village. We have been waiting for you. We need your help urgently!
But I am so sleepy now. Can you help me find some coffee to wake me up?
waitingMessages: I'm still so tired... Have you found the coffee?
postObjectMessages: Thank you for the coffee! I feel so much better now.

Here is the story of the evil black witch. There is a powerful and evil sorceress named Maginta Llennaspom. She was the most feared witch in the land and the most evil curse that she has ever cast was to unleash a black plague on the forest.
Mumu, you must help and find the antidote for this sickness and break her spell! You need to go and find the ingredients for the antidote. That's all I know. I wish you good luck!
finalMessages: I wish you good luck on your quest, Mumu!
